en.name: Muffins, homemade
en.summary: Homemade muffins — bran, blueberry, banana, corn, chocolate chip — keep 3–7 days at room temperature in a closed tub, and 2–3 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Refrigeration is not recommended: they dry out and go stale quickly in the fridge.
en.pantry: 3–7 days in a closed tub at room temperature, and expect the shorter end for anything wet. A banana or blueberry muffin carries a lot of fruit moisture, and that moisture migrates into the crumb and feeds mould, so it will not last as long as a plain bran or corn muffin. Cool them completely on a rack before they go in the tub — sealing warm muffins traps steam, which makes the tops sticky and brings mould forward by days. A muffin topped or filled with cream cheese, custard or fresh fruit is a perishable food and belongs in the fridge.
en.fridge: Refrigeration is not recommended: a muffin will quickly dry out and become stale in the fridge. Starch retrogradation runs fastest just above freezing, so the crumb firms and dries faster at 4 °C (40 °F) than it does on the counter. What the fridge does buy is time against mould, which is the real enemy for a fruit-heavy muffin in a hot humid kitchen — so if you must choose, choose the freezer, which stops mould without staling the crumb. Warming reverses some staling and does nothing about mould.
en.freezer: 2–3 months at −18 °C (0 °F) for best quality. Cool completely, wrap each muffin individually or bag them with the air pressed out, and freeze on baking day rather than after they have started to stale. Kept continuously frozen they stay safe well beyond that window — the timeline is about drying, ice crystals and freezer burn, not safety. Warm them from frozen in a low oven, which gives a much better result than a microwave.
en.thawing: Thaw wrapped at room temperature for an hour or two, or warm straight from frozen in a low oven. A muffin thawed in the fridge and still cold may be refrozen with some quality loss; one thawed on a warm counter should not be.
spoilage: Fuzzy mould spots, most often around a piece of fruit or in the paper case crease.
A sour or fermented smell from a batch sealed while still warm.
A dry, crumbly crumb that falls apart instead of tearing.
A rancid, crayon-like smell from the oil or butter in an old muffin.
tips: Cool completely on a rack before boxing; trapped steam is what brings mould forward.
Freeze half the batch on baking day instead of watching it go stale.
Line the tub with kitchen paper to absorb the moisture a fruit muffin gives off.
Homemade muffins have no mould inhibitor, so they will not match a packaged one.

faq.q: How long do homemade muffins keep?
faq.a: 3–7 days in a closed tub at room temperature, at the shorter end for wet ones like banana or blueberry. Frozen, 2–3 months at −18 °C (0 °F).
Yes, 2–3 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Cool them fully, wrap individually, freeze on baking day and warm from frozen in a low oven.
Not normally — refrigeration is not recommended because they dry out and stale quickly. Muffins topped with cream cheese, custard or fresh fruit are the exception and must be chilled.

zh.name: 自製瑪芬
zh.summary: 自己烤的瑪芬——麩皮、藍莓、香蕉、玉米、巧克力豆——裝在密閉盒裡放室溫可放 3～7 天，−18 °C 冷凍是 2～3 個月。不建議冷藏：放冷藏會很快變乾走味。
zh.pantry: 密閉盒裝、室溫 3～7 天，含水量高的請往短的那端抓。香蕉或藍莓瑪芬帶著大量水果水分，那些水分會往蛋糕體裡跑、餵養霉菌，所以它撐不了原味麩皮或玉米瑪芬那麼久。裝盒前一定要在架子上完全放涼——熱著就密封會困住蒸氣，讓表面發黏，也讓長霉的時間提早好幾天。表面有奶油乳酪、卡士達或新鮮水果的瑪芬是易腐食品，該放冷藏。
zh.fridge: 不建議冷藏：瑪芬放冷藏會很快變乾走味。澱粉回凝在略高於冰點時最快，所以在 4 °C 下，組織會比放在檯面上更快變硬變乾。冷藏買到的是對抗霉的時間，而在又熱又濕的廚房裡，霉正是水果瑪芬真正的敵人——所以如果非選不可，請選冷凍，它擋得住霉又不會讓組織老化。加熱可以逆轉一部分老化，但對霉毫無作用。
zh.freezer: −18 °C 下 2～3 個月品質最好。完全放涼，一顆一顆包好或整袋壓出空氣，而且要在出爐當天冷凍，不要等它已經開始走味。只要全程沒退冰，超過這個期限仍然安全——期限講的是變乾、冰晶和凍燒，不是安全。要吃時直接從冷凍用低溫烤箱回溫，效果遠勝微波。
zh.thawing: 包著在室溫放一兩個小時解凍，或直接從冷凍用低溫烤箱回溫。在冷藏解凍、還是冰的可以再冷凍，只是品質會打折；在溫暖檯面上解凍過的就不要再凍。
spoilage: 長出絨毛狀霉點，最常出現在水果顆粒旁邊或紙模的摺縫裡。
還熱著就密封的那一批，聞起來發酸或有發酵味。
組織乾到一碰就散，撕不出組織感。
放久了聞得到油耗味、像蠟筆的氣味。
tips: 在架子上完全放涼再裝盒；困住的蒸氣正是讓霉提早出現的原因。
出爐當天就先冷凍一半，好過眼睜睜看它變乾。
盒底鋪一張廚房紙巾，吸掉水果瑪芬釋出的水氣。
自製瑪芬沒有抑霉成分，本來就比不上市售包裝的耐放。

faq.a: 密閉盒裝放室溫 3～7 天；香蕉、藍莓這類含水高的請往短的抓。冷凍則是 −18 °C 下 2～3 個月。
可以，−18 °C 下 2～3 個月。完全放涼、一顆顆包好、出爐當天冷凍，要吃時直接低溫烤箱回溫。
一般不需要——冷藏不被建議，因為會很快變乾走味。但有奶油乳酪、卡士達或新鮮水果裝飾的那種是例外，一定要冰。
